_about: Silent web loops cut from real project footage by scripts/media/films.cjs. Sources: the Ampang film ROUANG_1.mp4 (videographer, VIDEOGRAPHER folder on the studio's Drive) and the Rembayung phone clips (Rembayung/Videos). Each segment was reviewed frame by frame: no people, no crew or installation, no house numbers, street names, table numbers or prices. Exterior shots, the children's bedroom and the home cinema were left out.
